move bar: A fixed camera looks down at a pale gray tabletop in an indoor room. Two short strips of black tape are stuck to the table, and a blue plastic bar, a hollow round tube, lies flat on the right-hand strip pointing away from the camera. A black robot arm with a two-finger parallel gripper reaches in from the top of the frame, brings the gripper down onto the far end of the bar, and moves the bar leftward across the table, the bar swinging to a slant as it travels, until it comes to rest on the left-hand strip of tape and leaves the strip it started on bare. The camera never moves and the lighting stays even.
pick up can: A fixed camera looks down at a pale gray tabletop in an indoor room. A green Sprite soda can stands upright on the table, with a small strip of black tape lying on the table to its left. A black robot arm with a two-finger parallel gripper reaches in from the top of the frame, descends until the open fingers straddle the can, closes them around the body of the can, and lifts the can clear of the table, raising it toward the top of the frame and uncovering a second strip of black tape where the can had been standing. The camera never moves and the lighting stays even.
pick up scissors: A fixed camera looks down at a pale gray tabletop in an indoor room. A pair of scissors with white handles and pale blue finger loops lies flat on the table with its blades pointing toward the lower left, and a small strip of black tape lies on the table to its right. A black robot arm with a two-finger parallel gripper reaches in from the top of the frame, descends toward the scissors, closes the fingers on them, and lifts the scissors clear of the table, raising them toward the top of the frame where they hang blade-down from the gripper and uncovering a second strip of black tape where they had been lying. The camera never moves and the lighting stays even.
